question: What was agreed at Halberd Security's renewal?

resolution.read_instruction: Extract everything that was agreed, decided or committed to in this renewal call: contract terms, length, pricing or discounts, seat or licence counts, expansion scope, features, deadlines, action items and who owns them, including any items left unresolved.
assumptions: Question refers to the Halberd Security call in the Renewal call type (CALL-013).

findings.speaker: Ruth Adeyemi
findings.quote: You're renewing in November, usage is healthy, six builders all active, error rate under one percent, and the only change is a seven percent standard uplift.
findings.context: Renewal is in November with a seven percent standard uplift as the only change. — Ruth's one-sentence renewal summary; Grace accepted it.

findings.speaker: Grace Okonkwo
findings.quote: Seven percent on a number that size is not worth an hour of my life.
findings.context: Grace Okonkwo accepted the seven percent uplift. — Customer acceptance of the renewal price change.

findings.speaker: Ruth Adeyemi
findings.quote: Renewal is agreed subject to papers — seven percent, no other changes, AI consumption estimate included.
findings.context: Renewal agreed subject to papers: seven percent, no other changes, and an AI consumption estimate included. — Ruth's closing summary of agreed items; Grace confirmed it as accurate.

findings.speaker: Ruth Adeyemi
findings.quote: For four hundred incidents a month it's not material. I'll put a number on it so nobody's surprised, but I don't think it changes your renewal.
findings.context: AI consumption charge is not expected to be material at about 400 incidents a month; a number will be put in the renewal papers. — Ruth's estimate; Grace asked for the number to be included anyway.

findings.speaker: Ruth Adeyemi
findings.quote: AI goes on in a contained workspace with two builders, after the fifty-incident test, subject to five written answers from Nina.
findings.context: AI goes on in a contained workspace with two builders, after a fifty-incident historical test, subject to written answers from Nina. — Agreed plan for AI features, which had been disabled at workspace level since purchase.

findings.speaker: Tobias Lund
findings.quote: I'll set that up. Two weeks.
findings.context: Tobias Lund committed to setting up the fifty-incident test in about two weeks. — Customer action item.

findings.speaker: Nina Patel
findings.context: Nina Patel owes written answers on AI-step permission granularity, run-record retention bucket, allowed model list, and subprocessor documentation; five answers were requested including publish permissions, with possibly four delivered by Friday. — Vendor action items; the count was reduced from five to four with the outstanding one identified later.

findings.speaker: Ruth Adeyemi
findings.quote: And you'll introduce a publish permission separate from a build permission, once we've confirmed the mechanism.
findings.context: Build permission to be separated from publish permission, with a two-person publish approach, once the mechanism is confirmed. — Governance item; Nina said the formal two-person gate is part of the pending permissions answer.

findings.speaker: Ruth Adeyemi
findings.quote: And the renewal papers from me by Wednesday.
findings.context: Renewal papers to be sent by Ruth by Wednesday. — Vendor deadline.

findings.speaker: Ruth Adeyemi
findings.quote: And the Teams approval scoping, which is exploratory rather than committed.
findings.context: Scoping of a Teams-based approval pattern is exploratory, not committed. — Raised by Tobias as an off-agenda item; Nina will include a rough shape, not an estimate.

findings.speaker: Ruth Adeyemi
findings.quote: It's thirty days for your contract.
findings.context: Contract provides thirty days notice of subprocessor changes. — Ruth checked the contract before the call.

findings.speaker: Nina Patel
findings.quote: We do not use customer workflow content to train a shared OrbitFlow model. That's in your contract, not just in the documentation.
findings.context: OrbitFlow does not use customer workflow content to train a shared OrbitFlow model, stated as a contract term. — Grace asked for this to be said on the call; Ruth pointed to clause fourteen.

draft.answer: Renewal was agreed subject to papers: a seven percent uplift, no other changes, and an AI consumption estimate included, which Grace Okonkwo accepted [C1][C2]. AI is to go live in a contained two-builder workspace after a fifty-incident test, subject to written answers from Nina Patel [C3][C4]. Ruth Adeyemi is to send the renewal papers by Wednesday [C5].

claims.text: Ruth Adeyemi's closing summary, confirmed by Grace as accurate: renewal (in November) is agreed subject to papers, with a seven percent uplift, no other changes, and an AI consumption estimate included.

Grace Okonkwo (CISO) accepted the seven percent uplift, saying it was not worth an hour of her life. Ruth estimated the AI consumption charge as not material at about 400 incidents a month, and will put a number in the papers anyway.

AI features, disabled at workspace level since purchase, will go on in a contained workspace with two builders after a fifty-incident historical test, subject to five written answers from Nina Patel. Tobias Lund committed to set up the test in about two weeks.

Nina Patel owes written answers on AI-step permission granularity, run-record retention bucket, allowed model list, and subprocessor documentation. Five were requested including publish permissions; possibly four are due by Friday.
Ruth is to send the renewal papers by Wednesday.

Build permission is to be separated from publish permission, with a two-person publish approach, once the mechanism is confirmed. Scoping of a Teams-based approval pattern is exploratory, not committed.

Ruth confirmed the contract gives thirty days notice of subprocessor changes. Nina stated OrbitFlow does not use customer workflow content to train a shared model, which is a contract term (clause fourteen per Ruth).

not_covered: Which of the five written answers is outstanding beyond Friday is not specified in the findings (the fifth relates to publish permissions).
Actual date of the November renewal and the dollar value are not given.
